scope: Model selected on Lankershim, development-only site calibration, actual raw source video; independent annotations never feed detection. Not a full CityFlow/UA-DETRAC box benchmark or physical twin acceptance.

full_window.scope: 1 Hz fixed-region world points, 4 m gate; conditional matched errors with coverage; not bounding-box IDF1, mAP, or ungated physical prediction accuracy

calibration_disjoint.scope: 1 Hz fixed-region world points, 4 m gate; conditional matched errors with coverage; not bounding-box IDF1, mAP, or ungated physical prediction accuracy

fresh_tracks.scope: 1 Hz fixed-region world points, 4 m gate; conditional matched errors with coverage; not bounding-box IDF1, mAP, or ungated physical prediction accuracy

performance.model: YOLOv8n-VisDrone / multiscale / OpenVINO FP32 integrated GPU

limitations: Spatial/temporal calibration checks are development diagnostics, not global accuracy bounds
Roof/footprint parallax and manual reference transcription uncertainty remain unquantified
Matched errors are conditional on a fixed 4 m gate; coverage and unmatched observations remain reported
Full-window and calibration-disjoint/fresh-track cohorts must not be silently substituted for each other
Reference session ends well before the complete raw video; no accuracy claim for the unannotated tail
